seed: Objects of type `counter` under action ACTION5 with touching neighbours [] show mixed outcomes: pixels,w x2, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the exact click position relative to the object, when the action is a click. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Player 5x5 moves 6px (A1-4) inside the field enclosed by the L-shaped wall cable; blocked by plug, field edge and an invisible cell (20,14) (hypothesis).
Counter: w=64-n//2 over all actions incl. an unseen step 0, so the A5 counter mixed outcome is action-count parity (continuity-gated hidden n), not click position.
A5 after moving: player to spawn (14,8, hypothesis); first A5 records the life path as a ghost (hud 2-box, player hud x+4), next A5 clears it; no-op if not moved.
Ghost replays recorded path one cell per effective player move, hidden while on the player; player/ghost on the 3x3 button pulls the plug 6px along the cable.
Wall re-extracted with actor occlusion; names re-indexed sequentially. Unconfirmed: spawn rule, (20,14) block, ghost pressing button, multi-ghost capacity.
